label: About
title: About Ivory Civic Cutaway Field
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 1212 recent saved-signal files and 314 captured links, then narrowed the page to 9 source windows around Anchor image material 1 and YouTube Playlists, plus 7 more. A source image from pbs.twimg.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became Ivory Civic Cutaway Field: Architectural section plate: a warm ivory civic cutaway field split into a left drafting-grid bay and a larger right silence field. One huge cropped matte-black A-like slab becomes a load-bearing tunnel crossing the divide. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 9 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against black diagonal civic slab with cropped interior edge, lower black bass-like horizontal ridge, and left pale drafting grid notch beside slab.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
